items.title: Jerry Blumberg Interview, 1961-04-06
items.q: This was Cuffee and Danny Barker and Kirkpatrick on piano and Groh and Steele... they all got along perfectly well together... they all just kind of smiled at each other all night. They all seemed to be enjoying the job very much.

ctx.x: Yeah, well, these fellas, they all got along perfectly well together. This is with... Who was the trombone? This was Cuffee and Danny Barker and Kirkpatrick on piano and Groh and Steele. And did we say Bushell? Yeah. No, we didn't make it. And Bunk. And they had a very warm thing going. There was very little talk. I mean, there was very little conversation between the musicians, but they all just kind of smiled at each other all night. They all seemed to be enjoying the job very much.
To Steele, the drummer, most of that engagement?
